- [2023/05/20] "Pay with Miles/Mix Miles and Cash" is a project allowing KrisFlyer members to use KF miles for payment or partial payment of commercial tickets and selected ancillaries on singaporeair.com.
- [2023/05/20] A minimum of approximately 1050 KF miles is required per transaction, with the conversion rate currently at SGD 1: 105 KF miles.
- [2023/05/20] Members can pay up to 100% of the commercial ticket using miles, including airport taxes and surcharges.
- [2023/05/20] Members cannot purchase miles to pay for tickets; purchase is only available for redeeming award tickets or flight upgrades.
- [2023/05/20] Members can use miles to pay for the commercial tickets of their nominees, with a maximum of 5 nominees allowed.
- [2023/05/20] KF miles payment option is only available for SIA operated flights and cannot be used for codeshare flights or bookings made through travel agents.
- [2023/05/20] The conversion rate from SGD to KF miles is not explicitly disclosed to members but is currently SGD 1 per 105 KF miles.
- [2023/05/20] KrisFlyer and Elite miles can be earned on tickets partially paid with KF miles, but only credited to the KF account.
- [2023/05/20] Commercial tickets paid with KF miles are non-endorsable, and redemption upgrades are allowed if the fare is in an upgradeable booking class.
- [2023/05/20] Refunds for tickets paid with KF miles prioritize refunding the cash amount first, with remaining amounts refunded in miles.
- [2023/05/20] Expired KF miles will not be refunded, and any applicable fees will be deducted from the oldest miles used.
- [2023/05/20] Members can submit refund requests for tickets paid with miles on SAA or through their nearest SIA office.
- [2023/05/20] Only KF members can use this payment option; OFFP members cannot use their miles from other FFP programs.
- [2023/05/20] Members can continue to redeem Saver, Standard, and Full Award tickets with KF miles.
- [2023/05/20] Infant tickets cannot currently be paid for with miles, but this feature is planned for future development.
